from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFilingMetric(BaseModel):
    """Financial per-share metric extracted from a single company filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    filing_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g. 'Basic Net Loss Per Share', 'Basic Earnings Per Share')")
    basic_eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported numerical value for the basic per-share metric")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g. 'dollars'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_filings: list[CompanyFilingMetric]
